claude_proposed_widenings.name: MagicItemMechanics.spawned_creature
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The item is a magic-item activation that creates and controls a temporary companion. Summoned-creature semantics exist for spells, but no magic-item mechanics family can currently express create-companion plus control/dismissal behavior.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: "While gently swinging this censer, you can take a Magic action to summon an Air Elemental."

claude_proposed_widenings.name: SpawnedCreatureMechanics.catalog_ref_stat_block
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The summoned creature is a named monster with an external stat block rather than an inline spell-specific stat block. The current summoned-creature surface only accepts an inline CreatureStatBlock, which would force an invented placeholder here.
